title: MeatekaMLInputSchema
description: Pre-posting feature schema for the Meateka Digital Content Engagement & Reach Predictor. Requires 13 pre-posting features. Post-event metrics (Likes, Comments, Shares, Views, Saves, Engagement_Rate) are strictly forbidden.

Content_Type.description: Media format type of the post.

Category.description: Domain or industry vertical of the content.

Day_of_Week.description: Day of the week scheduled for publishing.

Sentiment.description: Overall tone or emotional polarity of the caption copy.

Influencer_Tier.description: Audience size bracket of the creator account.

Hour_of_Day.description: Planned posting time in 24-hour format (0 to 23).

Month.description: Calendar month of publication (1 = January, 12 = December). Automatically derived from planned_posting_date if provided.

Hashtag_Count.description: Total number of hashtags attached to the post.

Content_Length.description: Character length of the caption text. Automatically calculated from caption string if provided.

Follower_Count.description: Total number of followers/subscribers of the creator.

Has_Media.description: Visual media flag. Set to true for With Media (photo/video), false for Text-Only.

Is_Verified.description: Creator badge verification flag. Set to true for Verified Creator, false for Regular Creator.

caption.description: Optional raw caption text. If Content_Length is omitted, Content_Length is automatically derived as len(caption.strip()).
caption.example: Check out this amazing street food recipe! #foodie #cooking

planned_posting_date.description: Optional planned publication date (YYYY-MM-DD). If Month is omitted, Month is automatically extracted from this date.

platforms.description: Optional list of platforms to evaluate simultaneously in platform comparison.
